templates.name: Heartbeat keeper
templates.description: Decide whether, when and how an idle agent should continue current commitments.

templates.name: Quota keeper
templates.description: Monitor provider quota, notify and coordinate authorized runtime account recovery.

options.label: Longest interval when idle (seconds)
options.description: Each run that finds nothing to do doubles the wait, up to this; a run that does something returns to the configured interval. 0 keeps the interval fixed.

templates.name: Hotseat switcher
templates.description: Switch the default Claude or Codex account through Hotseat before its quota window runs out.

options.label: Codex check interval (seconds)
options.description: Codex quota is probed per saved profile, so check it less often.

options.label: Claude floor: 5-hour window percent remaining
options.description: Switch when the account in use is under this and another account is at or above it. Below the floor the ladder drops to 10%, then 0%.

options.label: Codex floor: weekly window percent remaining
Repair saved Claude authentication
options.description: Optional exact-profile repair; repaired authentication is verified separately from usable quota and model limits.

options.label: Longest interval when idle (seconds)
options.description: Each run that finds nothing to do doubles the wait, up to this; a run that does something returns to the configured interval. 0 keeps the interval fixed.

templates.name: Task labels
templates.description: Keep agents' current task labels clear and useful.

options.label: Longest interval when idle (seconds)
options.description: Each run that finds nothing to do doubles the wait, up to this; a run that does something returns to the configured interval. 0 keeps the interval fixed.

templates.name: Scheduled task
templates.description: On a schedule, carry out the configured instructions in this Janitor's own workspace. Runs that find nothing to do back off, up to a day.

options.label: Instructions
options.description: What each run does. Delivered as the run's prompt, with the closing-report contract.

options.label: Longest interval when idle (seconds)
options.description: Each run that finds nothing to do doubles the wait, up to this; a run that does something returns to the configured interval. 0 keeps the interval fixed.

templates.name: Message delegator
templates.description: Choose an eligible recipient for an explicitly requested message route.

options.label: Only when name matching cannot decide
options.description: Ask the delegator when the recipient cannot be selected directly from an agent name.

templates.name: Audio bookkeeper
templates.description: Record producer and client-reported audio lifecycle facts deterministically; no model or primary-agent skill.

templates.name: Label checker
templates.description: Hourly, ask Jev whether each working agent's label still describes what it is doing, and list the ones that do not in Updates. Report only; needs the labels judgment site.

options.label: Correct labels automatically
options.description: Reserved. Mismatches are only reported today; nothing is changed.

options.label: Longest interval when idle (seconds)
options.description: Each run that finds nothing to do doubles the wait, up to this; a run that does something returns to the configured interval. 0 keeps the interval fixed.

templates.name: Goal keeper
templates.description: Keep agents' durable goals current beside them: after a turn, a helper's report, a job or a pause, restate the goal's steps and write a short checkpoint. The agents are never prompted; it cannot complete, pause or cancel a goal or record evidence.

options.label: Goals updated at once
options.description: One run updates up to this many goals in parallel; each is one model call.

templates.name: Tool explainer
templates.description: Explain requested tool activity using bounded read-only input.

options.label: Tool detail
options.description: Choose how requested tool activity is explained. Developer keeps the original activity.

options.label: Explanation sources
options.description: Known tool calls use scripted templates; Jev can pick a known template for unfamiliar ones when its judgment site is on; the configured model explains the rest.
